Every time they point to the perilous signs of a godless world, the violence, the division, the decay, remind them gently, most of those signs are coming from fellow believers, from people who believe in a God, who pray to a God, who read scriptures that they believe came down from a God, people who act not in the absence of faith, but in the name of it.
